package.name: crusader_bt
package.description:
Missions as behaviour trees. bt_runner_node is Crusader's bt_navigator: it exposes ONE coarse action per mission and ticks a tree of primitive leaves inside it, the same shape Nav2 uses.
nav_math.hpp holds every piece of geometry and depends on nothing but the standard library, so the arithmetic that can be silently wrong is compiled and tested on a laptop rather than discovered on the water. The leaves on top of it read a port, call nav_math, publish and poll.
